# Takt

> Takt is free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) task management software for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Android, Wear OS and the terminal, published by MaybeItsSoftware. Plan the day, then do it: a ranked Today list, an outline, a board, focus timers and dailies, driven from the keyboard or a tap.

Takt's apps are free and work fully offline with no account; signing in is only for sync. Sync is either self-hosted with the server in the repository (free, every feature) or through Takt's hosted server with Takt Sync, £1 a year, the one in-app purchase, bought in the iPhone or Android app and covering every device on the account. There are no ads and no analytics or tracking SDKs. The `takt` command-line tool includes an MCP server that exposes the whole workspace (tasks, lists, dailies, focus sessions) to an AI assistant.

- Platforms: macOS 15.6+, iPhone and iPad, Android and Wear OS, and a terminal CLI
- Source code: https://github.com/MaybeItsSoftware/takt (GNU AGPL-3.0)
- Publisher: MaybeItsSoftware (https://maybeitssoftware.co.uk); created by Adam Cleary
